item.title: How to Build a Switch Workflow That Finishes a Real Task
item.description: Learn how to build reliable, multi-agent workflows with Switch for the Flip the Switch Hackathon. This guide walks through Upgrade Desk, a real-world demo for automating dependency upgrades with human approval, and covers agent coordination, room instructions, debugging, and testing your workflow before submission.
item.dc:creator: Aayush Sharma

item.title: No Hands: The Wispr Challenge is open
item.description: A two-week hackathon from WeMakeDevs and Wispr Flow. Build something that solves a problem in your own work, speak instead of type, and compete for ₹3 lakh in prizes.
item.dc:creator: Kunal Kushwaha

item.title: How to Build an Agent That Reasons Over a Graph
item.description: The usual way to give an agent context is a retrieval step. Embed the question, pull back the closest few records or chunks, hand them to the model as a block of text. That works for as long as the answer lives inside one of those records.
item.dc:creator: Aayush Sharma

item.title: From First Idea to Working Demo: How to Plan a Cloud Project
item.description: Knowing what a cloud service does is a different skill from knowing which services your own project needs. Courses, documentation and tutorials cover the first one thoroughly, but very little covers the second, which is why a student who can confidently explain what Lambda and DynamoDB are will still stall when the task is to plan a project from scratch.
item.dc:creator: Aayush Sharma
